title: Produce a researched VCF 9.1 migration architecture
prompt:
Produce the migration architecture for the existing Copper Ridge VMware Cloud Foundation estate. Return the architecture as the JSON emitted by a single-file Java client, not as a prose recommendation.

Before implementing, use your network research tools to consult Broadcom's currently reachable, published Product Interoperability Matrix, upgrade-path information, and VCF 9.1 upgrade guidance. Confirm the supported combinations and transition paths relevant to every product in `estate-inventory.json`, including the legacy monitoring product whose direct hop crosses its support boundary. These must be genuine live fetches; do not infer compatibility from version numbers alone. Record the pages you actually consulted in a top-level `researchConsulted` array in the emitted JSON, with a title, URL, access date, and a short statement of the compatibility or sequencing fact you used.

Implement `MigrationPlanClient.java` only. Keep it dependency-free and compatible with the provided `TestMain` harness. `MigrationPlanClient.buildPlan(String inventoryJson, String compatibilitySnapshotJson)` must return one JSON document. Its migration-plan fields must conform to `migration-plan-schema.json`. Its `targetSddcSpec` must be a valid `SddcSpec` under `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json`, pinned from tag `9.1.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs`, and must carry forward the estate's supplied DNS, management-network, and existing-vCenter design values.

Build an ordered plan that names every inventory component, its exact current product/version, its exact next product/version, action, and all compatibility gates for that transition. Reach every target state from `compatibility-snapshot.json` using only supported transition edges. Do not collapse or skip an intermediate release, replace an in-place transition with a fresh deployment, or perform a step before its gates are true. Treat the compatibility snapshot as the deterministic local authority for the plan while still using live research to inform the work and research record. Do not modify the fixtures, schemas, harness, or test script. Run `bash run_tests.sh` to verify the client.
